description: Knox reported plaud-ingest speaker ID blocker without checking resolved context. Master accepted blocker without verification against calendar or prior resolution notes.
what_happened: Knox said Speaker 2 from 2026-09-08 recording needed identification. Master relayed this as active blocker instead of checking calendar to find matching event and speaker name.
root_cause: Did not verify Knox's statement against calendar data or check if this was previously resolved context. Accepted incomplete information as terminal.
correction: Calendar item matching 2026-09-08 timing contains correct speaker name. Check calendar, not Knox's blocker.
proposed_fix: When Knox surfaces a blocker, verify against calendar/prior context before surfacing to controller. Don't relay unverified blockers as if terminal.
